programme.title: Семейные мелодрамы
programme.desc: Это не выдуманные истории, а реконструкция реальных событий, которые могут случиться с каждой семьей. В каждой семье свои "Семейные мелодрамы", конфликты, накопившиеся проблемы с долговыми ямами, изменами, трудными детьми и конфликтами с родителями. Какой выход из этих ситуаций, достигших наивысшего апогея, когда никто не хочет его искать? Как же тогда жить дальше? Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

programme.title: The Groomsmen
programme.desc: A 30-something man decides to marry his pregnant girlfriend and asks his four best friends to stand with him at the wedding, but as he observes his friends relationship troubles, he wrestles with issues of fatherhood, marriage and growing up.

programme.title: Crown Vic
programme.desc: A night patrol in L.A. with veteran officer Ray Mandel and ambitious rookie Nick Holland takes an unexpected turn. In order to control the gangs fighting them they'll need much more than the Crown Victoria police cruiser.

programme.title: People You May Know
programme.desc: People You May Know follows Jed, a 30-something introvert who has managed to abstain from social media until now. When prompted with the gargantuan task of defining who he is, he realizes the life he can fake is much more interesting than the life he actually leads.

programme.title: The Waiting
programme.desc: Jean Barreau leads a spiritual commune on the countryside with the promise of a second life. When their doubles arrive at the house, his followers learn that Jean meant this promise quite literally. However, not everybody is as easily swayed by their capricious leader, who eventually starts to question his own beliefs.

programme.title: Uncle Nino
programme.desc: A distant, slightly dysfunctional family is brought closer together when the father's long-estranged Uncle Nino comes from Italy to Chicago for a surprise visit.

programme.title: The Adventure Scouts
programme.desc: A coming of age movie about a group of boys and girls called "adventure scouts" who return from a camping trip to discover their small town is being held captive by a gang of motorcycle-riding knuckleheads. Using only their scouting knowledge and camping equipment, the kids take down the gang members one by one, reunite with family members, and restore the community's sense of pride.

programme.title: Summer Dreams
programme.desc: Seventeen-year old Robbie Zirpollo has a problem. As the film opens, his mother is driving him to his new summer job. We learn that Robbie has grown up in Oceanside, California, but now he and his mother have moved to Colorado for a fresh start, as his father has taken the family's savings and his secretary to Mexico. Robbie's mom has, through an uncle, gotten him a summer job at Water World on the grounds crew. The adventure begins when Robbie meets Alex and gets moved to Aokee's Surf & Snack shack to work. Alex convinces Robbie to enter the park's "Employee Olympics" to bring the Surfer King trophy to it's rightful place among the concessions crew. Tiffany, the park owner's daughter, has other ideas for Robbie.

programme.title: The Lucky Dragon
programme.desc: A young, Chinese dragon punished by the gods to be a mere mortal is cast down to earth. He is forced to make his way in a strange land until the evil forces discover his true identity. Take part in a world full of imagination while following the journey of a mischievous dragon who has been transformed by magic into a little boy and exiled from his home to live among humans. When both good and evil forces learn that a dragon has arrived, they look for him as he is the only one who can find the magical sword—whose owner can rule the universe! Will he find the sword in time before it gets into the wrong hands? Will he ever become a dragon again?

programme.title: Railroad Tigers
programme.desc: In December 1941, Japan expands the occupation of its neighbouring countries to Southeast Asia. The railway from Tianjin to Nanjing in East China became a key military transportation route, heavily guarded by Japanese soldiers. Railroad worker Ma Yuan (Jackie Chan) leads a team of freedom fighters. Using his deep knowledge of the train network, he and his men sabotage it, ambushing Japanese soldiers and stealing supplies to feed the starving Chinese. Although the freedom fighters have no weapons of their own, they employ whatever tools are at hand, including a hammer and shovels, loose railway track planks and diverted trains. The local Chinese call the unlikely heroes the "Railroad Tigers". The freedom fighters find themselves on the wrong side of the tracks when the Japanese send reinforcements to Shandong. In an act of defiance, Ma Yuan launches his most dangerous mission yet, blowing up a heavily guarded railroad bridge. When the Japanese learn of the crippling plan, which will derail the war effort, the stakes are raised even higher. After many missed opportunities and missed shots, the bridge is blown up by the ragtag Chinese railroad tigers.

programme.title: Corner Office
programme.desc: Orson, a compulsive bureaucrat who discovers a secret room.

programme.title: Rat Race
programme.desc: Donald P. Sinclair has placed six separate gold coins in different slot machines in his casino. The lucky six who find these coins discover an opportunity of a lifetime. The chance to own $2 million. Locked up in a locker in New Mexico, these six contestants must now race each other, to be the first to the cash. There are no rules in place and everything that could possibly happen, does. Whilst, behind the scenes, Sinclair's associates are placing their bets.

programme.title: Lost in Florence
programme.desc: When Eleroo advises Bumblelion to make a wish when getting the biggest part of the wishbone, it means trouble for poor Rhinokey for losing two bank bags of money. Bumblelion starts spending the money and looses his friends while Rhinokey manages to escape from Officer Eaglebeagle. Rhinokey tries to convince Bumblelion to return the bank bags, but Bumblelion decides to run off thinking that Rhinokey wants to steal his money. Soon after, Bumblelion realizes how Rhinokey lost the bank bags and returns the money to the police.

programme.title: Shoreditch
programme.desc: In London 1939, before the beginning of the Second World War, Thomas and his wife Massie run the Say When jazz club. But when he starts having an affair with singer Butterfly, their world disintegrates into blackmail, drugs, and suicide.

programme.title: The 51st State
programme.desc: In Ronny Yu's fast-moving crime-thriller, Samuel L Jackson plays Elmo McElroy, a pharmaceutical genius who has made a fortune in illegal drugs, particularly with Formula 51, which is more potent than heroin and crack. But instead of selling it to his drug lord employer the Lizard (Meatloaf), he flies to Liverpool where Felix (Robert Carlyle) is acting as broker for gangster Leopold Durant (Ricky Tomlinson). Durant is prepared to offer $20m for the formula; money Elmo would love to spend, if he can stay alive long enough.

programme.title: Land Of the Blind
programme.desc: A soldier recounts his relationship with a famous political prisoner attempting to overthrow their country's authoritarian government.

programme.title: Operation Chromite
programme.desc: In 1950, just a few months after North Korean forces have overrun most of South Korea, an American-led United Nations Command is deployed to Korea to aid the struggling South Koreans. General Douglas MacArthur devises a secret plan to attack behind enemy lines at the port city of Incheon. The risky strategy is opposed by leaders of the other military branches, forcing MacArthur to devise a clandestine operation to gather essential information from within occupied Incheon by coordinating a weeklong South Korean intelligence operation known as "X-Ray".

programme.title: The Recall
programme.desc: The great Wesley Snipes (Blade himself!) stars as "The Hunter" in this Mauro Borrelli (The Ghostmaker) directed film. The Recall also stars RJ Mitte (Breaking Bad), Jedidiah Goodacre (Descendants), Niko Pepaj (Awkward), Laura Maria Bilgeri (Toby Goes to Camp) and Hannah Rose May (Ballers). The movie tells the tale of five friends vacationing at a remote lake house, expecting nothing less than a good time. Unbeknownst to them, Earth is under an alien invasion and in the thralls of a mass-abduction. Director Borelli is a former collaborator of director Tim Burton and the film illustrator for blockbuster films such as Pirates of the Caribbean and Captain America. The Recall will also be shot for the new Barco Escape three-screen, panoramic theatrical format, which fully surrounds audiences and offers the ultimate immersive cinema experience. Portions of the films will also be shot in Virtual Reality.

programme.title: Caesar
programme.desc: Epic look at Julius Caesar, Rome's last dictator, whose death also signaled the end of the Roman Republic. Chronicles his campaigns in Gaul and Egypt, his rivalry with General Pompey, and his eventual assassination at the hands of Brutus and Cassius.

programme.title: Train Master
programme.desc: 62 year old Jeremiah Wilson is truly the Train Master of Willamette Western Railroad. He lives, breaths, and eats railroad. When Brett Banner, 32 year old heir to New York Eastern talks his dad into purchasing Willamette Western, there is immediately a clash between himself and Jeremiah. Jeremiah is fired by Brett two years from retirement and turns into a angry, depressed grandfather. When Brett's nine year old son Justin realizes Jeremiah's grandson Thomas can drive a locomotive, he kidnaps and holds Thomas' favorite dinosaur ransom. Justin, Thomas and 3 other children board an old engine in for repairs and accidentally turns it into runaway engine causing a chain reaction of events.

programme.title: Timber the Treasure Dog
programme.desc: A boy rises to the occasion with his best friend (a lovable talking dog) to save his home and family.

programme.title: Digging Into China
programme.desc: Harriet, a ten-year old girl, lives together with her big sister and her alcoholic mother out in the countryside. The family runs a motel. Harriet is different from the others, as she owns a great creativity and has nobody to play with. Her infinite world exists only in her mind. One day, Ricky comes along. He is a grown-up, but retarded son of an elderly lady. Soon, Harriet and Ricky share their experiences of life from a different point of view and become close friends. But his mother still plans to give Ricky away into professional care in a home, because she won't live forever to be there for him.

programme.title: No Limit Kids
programme.desc: Ashton, Celeste, and Becca are three unlikely middle school outcasts who form a club in an abandoned theater. There, they meet Charlie (Bill Cobbs, Night at the Museum), a homeless man who shares their passion for musical theater. When the theater is scheduled to be torn down, the teenagers set out to save the landmark with a modern-day performance of Shakespeare's Much Ado About Nothing. Along the way, the group learns to treat others with respect and stand up for their beliefs. This Dove-approved film also features Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Lee Meriwether.

programme.title: Irish Jam
programme.desc: A South Central L.A. con artist with rap skills tries to keep bill collectors and his lover, with marriage in mind, at bay by entering a poetry contest staged by a small Irish town. Can his rhyming skills help the town and win him the prize money?

programme.title: Decembers
programme.desc: The ghost of a photojournalist killed during the American invasion of Panama in December 1989 returns exactly ten years later to resolve family conflicts.

programme.title: North & South: The Battle of New Market
programme.desc: Based on a true story of the American Civil War, culminating at the Battle of New Market, May 1864. A group of teenage cadets sheltered from war at the Virginia Military Institute must confront the horrors of an adult world when they are called upon to defend the Shenandoah Valley. Leaving behind their youth, these cadets must decide what they are fighting for.

programme.title: The Magnificent Ambersons
programme.desc: The spoiled rotten and utterly unlikable rich kid George Amberson becomes horrified when his recently widowed mother rekindles her relationship with the wealthy Eugene Morgan, who she left decades earlier in order to marry George's father. As George struggles to sabotage his mother's new romance, he must deal with his own romantic feelings for Morgan's daughter and the consequences of his meddling as his once great family falls into ruin due to his machinations...

programme.title: Remembrance
programme.desc: Remembrance depicts a remarkable love story that blossomed amidst the terror of a German concentration camp in 1944 Poland. This impossible passion fuels the courage of a Polish prisoner who manages to rescue his Jewish girlfriend. Against all odds, they escape the camp and survive a treacherous journey to freedom. But during the chaos of the end of the war, they are forcibly separated and each is convinced that the other has died. More than thirty years later in New York, the happily married 52-year-old woman accidentally finds out that her former Polish lover is still alive. And she has to see him again.

programme.title: Deserter
programme.desc: Unlikely friends in a melting pot of confusion. Simon Murray fights for the French Foreign Legion. Pascal Dupont fights for himself. War torn men question honour, hope, morality...because you can desert everything...except yourself.

programme.title: Black Cop
programme.desc: A black police officer gets pushed to the edge after he is profiled and assaulted by the colleagues he worked side by side with, so he decides to get revenge and take his frustrations out on the community that he swore to protect.

programme.title: Existenz
programme.desc: A game designer on the run from assassins must play her latest virtual reality creation with a marketing trainee to determine if the game has been damaged.

programme.title: Unexpected
programme.desc: Bob and Amy are at a crossroads: she wants to adopt a child, he doesn't. Will renovating their house and rescuing animals solve their problems? Will their new handyman and his son's pregnant girlfriend be the miracle they're looking for?...

programme.title: Matriks. Revolūcija

programme.title: Divas Megijas
programme.desc: Lieliski savērpta melnā komēdija, kas aizved skatītājus negaidītā ceļojumā uz šķietami parastu pilsētiņu. Putekļainajā tuksneša pilsētelē, kur nekad nekas nenotiek, policijas priekšniekam pēkšņi jāatrisina divas slepkavības pēc kārtas, kurās nogalinātas sievietes ar vienādu vārdu. Kriminālkomēdijas režisors ir Džons Sleterijs (seriāls "Mad Men"), galvenjās lomās Niks Mohameds (seriāls "Ted Lasso"), Džons Hems (seriāls "Mad Men", "Top Gun: Maveriks") un Tīna Feja ("Māsas", seriāls "30 Rock").

programme.desc: Skots un Keita Johanseni ir spiesti atrast veidus, kā iegūt naudu savas meitas skološanai - viņa nav ieguvusi kāroto stipendiju. Kad šķiet, ka viss ir pajucis, pāris nolemj apvienot spēkus ar kaimiņu Frenku, kopīgi mājās izveidojot pagrīdes kazino.

programme.desc: Kāds jauneklis uzsāk atriebības kampaņu pret korumpētajiem līderiem, kuri nogalināja viņa māti un turpina sistemātiski vajāt nabadzīgos un bezspēcīgos.

programme.title: Uz nažiem
programme.desc: Uzreiz pēc astoņdesmit piektās jubilejas nogalināts detektīvromānu autors un kuplas ģimenes patriarhs Harlans Trombijs. Slepkavības izmeklēšanu uzsāk harizmātiskais un skrupulozais detektīvs Benuā Blanks, kuram acumirklī kļūst skaidrs – slepkavību ir pastrādājis kāds no Trombija plašās ģimenes locekļiem. Bet kurš tieši? Atjautības spēle uz dzīvību un nāvi ir sākusies!

Džona F. Kenedija lidostā gandrīz notiek divu lidmašīnu sadursme. Notikušajā tiek vainots satiksmes kontrolieris Dilans, kurš notikuma laikā, tieši plkst. 14:22 redzējis neizskaidrojamu gaismu un nav bijis spējīgs pildīt savus pienākumus. Viņš tiek atstādināts no darba un iepazīstas ar Sāru, kura bijusi pasažiere vienā no lidmašīnām. Abu starpā uzreiz uzplaukst jūtas, taču viņi sāk novērot savādas lietas - it kā diena ietu pa apli, un tieši plkst. 14:22 atkal sāk atkārtoties tie paši notikumi, viņi satiek tos pašus cilvēkus. Lai izkļūtu no šī apburtā loka, viņiem nāksies atšķetināt sarežģītas mistērijas. Galvenajās lomās: Maiks Huizmans, Teresa Palmere, Sems Rīds

programme.title: Ķīniešu mīkla
programme.desc: Kzavjē dzīve ir sarežģītāka nekā jebkad iepriekš. Viņš ir rakstnieks, dzīvo Parīzē kopā ar savu bērnu māti Vendiju, kura pēc ceļojuma uz Ņujorku paziņo, ka vēlas šķirties, jo satikusi kādu citu. Parīzē dzīvo arī Kzavjē draudzene Izabella, kura ir kopā ar ķīniešu izcelsmes amerikānieti. Sievietes vēlas bērnu un pierunā Kzavjē kļūt par spermas donoru, pirms pašas pārvāksies uz Ņujorku. Kad arī Vendija paziņo, ka kopā ar bērniem pārvāksies uz Ņujorku pie vīrieša, ar kuru nesen iepazinās, Kzavjē saprot, ka viņam nav izvēles - ja visi viņa bērni būs Ņujorkā, arī viņam jādodas turp.

programme.title: Melnais gulbis
programme.desc: Ņujorkas baleta trupas balerīnas Ninas dzīve ir deja. Viņa dzīvo kopā ar māti Ēriku, kas ir izbijusi balerīna un aizgūtnēm atbalsta meitas profesionālās ambīcijas. Kad mākslinieciskais režisors izlemj nomainīt prīmu izrādē "Gulbju ezers", viņa izvēle ir tieši Nina. Tomēr viņai uzrodas konkurente - jaunā dejotāja Lilī, kuras sniegums arī aizrauj režisoru. Izrādei ir vajadzīga dejotāja, kas spēj nodejot gan Balto gulbi ar nevainību un grāciju, kā arī Melno gulbi, kas iemieso viltu un jutekliskumu. Nina pilnībā atbilst Baltā tēlam, bet Lilī ir Melnā gulbja iemiesojums. Kad jaunās dejotājas uzsāk sāncensību par šo lomu, viņu draudzība kļūst arvien sarežģītāka un Nina arvien vairāk saskaras ar draudzenes rakstura tumšo pusi un abas ir gatavas viena otru iznīcināt.

programme.title: Kliko kundze
programme.desc: Pēc vīra pāragrās nāves Barba Nikola Ponsardēna Kliko pretstatā pieņemtajām normām pārņem jaunā vīndarīšanas uzņēmuma grožus, ko abi ar vīru bija veidojuši. Vadot uzņēmumu cauri politiskām un finanšu grūtībām, viņa ignorē kritiķus un rada revolūciju šampanieša industrijā, kļūstot par vienu no pasaules pirmajām, dižajām darījumu sievietēm.

Pagājuši trīspadsmit gadi kopš šausminošā notikušā, un dzīve viņiem piespēlē nebijušu iespēju - pārcelties uz dzīvi ASV. Kanzasā viņus sagaida nodarbinātības aģentūras darbiniece Kerija Deivisa. programme.title: Aiz kraujas rudzu laukā
programme.desc: "Aiz kraujas rudzu laukā" ir ieskats notikumos, kas veidoja vienu no pretrunīgākajiem un noslēpumainākajiem amerikāņu rakstniekiem – Dž. D. Selindžeru. Filmas darbība risinās 20. gadsimta vidū Ņujorkā, kad jaunais Selindžers meklē savu vietu dzīvē. Pārciestais frontē 2. Pasaules karā, mīlas dēka ar augstāko aprindu jaunkundzi Ūnu O'Nīlu un pirmie literārie centieni – šī pieredze ir pamatā viņa pasaulē, iespējams, slavenākajam literārajam meistardarbam "Uz kraujas rudzu laukā". Galvenās lomas atveido jaunais britu aktieris Nikolass Holts un sevi jau pierādījušais ASV kino meistars Kevins Speisijs.

programme.title: Ūdens forma
programme.desc: Godalgodais režisors un vizualizācijas meistars Giljermo Del Toro piedāvā aizkustinošu stāstu, kura darbība norisinās 1962. gadā - aukstā kara laikā ASV. Kādā slēgtā valdības laboratorijā strādā apkopēja Elaiza, kura kopā ar savu kolēģi Zeldu nejauši atklāj tur rūpīgi slēptu kādu neparastu būtni.

programme.title: Mana Māsīca Reičela
programme.desc: Filips ir jauns anglis, kura brālēns Ambrozs pēc došanās uz Florenci Itālijā nomirst. Viņš zvēr atriebību Ambroza sievai Reičelai, vainojot viņu visās nelaimēs.

programme.title: Ciao House
programme.desc: Hosts and judges Alex Guarnaschelli and Gabe Bertaccini welcome 10 talented chefs to Ciao House, where they will live together in a beautiful Tuscan villa and be tested like never before on their proficiency with Italian cuisine. Two chefs receive a huge advantage going into the next round, and one chef must say "Ciao Ciao" to the villa.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.title: Bizarre Foods
programme.desc: Travel and cuisine documentary series, hosted by famous Andrew Zimmern, American culinary expert, chef, restaurateur and television personality and spin-off series of ''Bizarre Foods'', focuses on classic, iconic foods (not bizarre like in the original series) from some well-known destinations- moussaka and real Greek yogurt from Athens, sweet macarons and crepes from Paris, Italian gelato, gooey fondue to Swiss chocolate from Zurich, mile-high pastrami sandwiches and bagels from NYC, and many other legendary foods. The show will explore where these dishes came from, how they're prepared, and the best way to enjoy them. Andrew will also discover some secrets and interesting stories behind these epic meals.

programme.title: Cake Boss
programme.desc: Carlo's Bakery in Hoboken New Jersey create elaborate, elegant and interesting edible art cakes. Cake Boss follows the team, led by Buddy Valastro, as they design and create two of these masterpieces for all kinds of events and occassions. The show explores the intricacy of working with your family, and their interpersonal relationships with other employees. Watch as they create everything from classic wedding cakes to alien spaceships.

programme.title: Man v Food
programme.desc: Every region has its own local culture and flavor. One of the best ways for a traveler to immerse him or herself in new destinations is to taste these unique dishes. Food, host Adam Richman sets out to travel the country in search of the best places to do some serious indulging. Starting season 5, Casey Webb took over as host.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ree Drummond is cleaning out her kitchen by turning leftovers into amazing dishes. She starts in the pantry with Brown Sugar Buttermilk Waffles with a sensational brown sugar syrup and uses her frozen odds and ends to build a perfect Cheesy Freezer Chicken Pot Pie. Then, the fridge scraps are in the spotlight in a Loaded Egg Salad Sandwich, and a final run through the pantry turns into a Bean and Bacon Soup, a well-earned lunch for Ladd, who's spending the morning moving cattle.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Take one sassy former city girl, her hunky rancher husband and a band of adorable kids, an extended family, cowboys, 3000 wild mustangs, a herd of cattle and one placid basset hound and you have The Pioneer Woman. The Pioneer Woman is an open invitation into Ree Drummond's life: The award-winning blogger and best-selling cookbook author comes to Food Network and shares her special brand of home cooking, from throw-together suppers to elegant celebrations. The series, set against the incredible story of life at home on the range, is the next best thing to actually sitting on a stool in Ree's kitchen.

programme.title: BBQ Brawl: Flay V. Symon

Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.title: BBQ Brawl: Flay V. Symon
programme.desc: Join our hosts, renowned celebrity chefs and restaurateurs Bobby Flay and Michael Symon, as they test the skills of eight expert barbecue connoisseurs. Filmed at the Star Hill Ranch in Austin, Texas, the eight chefs are divided into two teams but, in order to claim first pick for their team, Bobby and Michael go head-to-head in a backyard BBQ challenge. Each episode sees one of the chefs being eliminated from the show until there is only one left, the winner who is awarded the title of 'Master of Cue'. The weekly contests aim to reveal the chefs' talents and expose their weaknesses and include tasks such as cooking up a tomahawk rib-eye and taking on a Texas beef challenge.

programme.title: Dinner: Impossible
programme.desc: Robert Irvine is ready for any challenge he is challenged to overcome culinary obstacles and deliver a delicious meal before his time runs out. With new challenges from this exciting, fun-loving chef, viewers will see if Robert can make dinner, possible!

programme.title: Bizarre Foods
programme.desc: Travel and cuisine documentary series, hosted by famous Andrew Zimmern, American culinary expert, chef, restaurateur and television personality and spin-off series of ''Bizarre Foods'', focuses on classic, iconic foods (not bizarre like in the original series) from some well-known destinations- moussaka and real Greek yogurt from Athens, sweet macarons and crepes from Paris, Italian gelato, gooey fondue to Swiss chocolate from Zurich, mile-high pastrami sandwiches and bagels from NYC, and many other legendary foods. The show will explore where these dishes came from, how they're prepared, and the best way to enjoy them. Andrew will also discover some secrets and interesting stories behind these epic meals.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: In Memphis, Tennessee, a father's passion project has turned into a nightmare. Owner Tyrone Clements has lost his way, and his family fast-food American restaurant, 'Big Dawgs Memphis' at 3057 Thomas St., is suffering because of it. The eatery serves fare such as chicken wings, hot dogs, sausages, hamburgers and sandwiches. Robert Irvine must teach Tyrone about more than just the 'ins and outs' of running a restaurant before this family loses their livelihood and their bond.

programme.desc: In this all-new series, teams comprised of two chefs from different generations will tackle challenges in which they must mesh retro ingredients with today's viral food trends to bridge the culinary gap and show off their expertise.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Take one sassy former city girl, her hunky rancher husband and a band of adorable kids, an extended family, cowboys, 3000 wild mustangs, a herd of cattle and one placid basset hound and you have The Pioneer Woman. The Pioneer Woman is an open invitation into Ree Drummond's life: The award-winning blogger and best-selling cookbook author comes to Food Network and shares her special brand of home cooking, from throw-together suppers to elegant celebrations. The series, set against the incredible story of life at home on the range, is the next best thing to actually sitting on a stool in Ree's kitchen.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives is American food reality television series about places with the most delicious food. The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

programme.title: Dauntonas abatija: Lielais noslēgums
programme.desc: Krouliju ģimene un Dauntonas abatijas personāls bauda spožo Londonas sezonu 1930. gada vasarā. Lēdijas Pītersfīldas ballē – augstākās sabiedrības spilgtākajā notikumā – kāds šokējošs paziņojums ievelk lēdiju Mēriju skandāla virpulī. Drīz viņas ģimene saskaras ar finansiālām grūtībām, un Dauntonas abatijai draud grūti laiki. Ģimenei ir jāpieņem tuvojošās pārmaiņas, kurās ģimenes jaunā paaudze pavērs Dauntonas abatijai durvis uz jaunu nākotni.

programme.title: Didi
programme.desc: 2008. gadā, pēdējā vasaras mēnesī pirms vidusskolas sākuma, 13 gadus vecs zēns iemācās to, ko viņa ģimene nevar viņam iemācīt: kā slidot, kā flirtēt un kā mīlēt savu mammu.

programme.title: Mīlu tevi ienīst
programme.desc: Bea un Bens izskatās pēc ideālā pāra, bet pēc brīnišķīga pirmā randiņa notiek kas tāds, kas pārvērš viņu ugunīgo pievilkšanās spēku ledus aukstumā – līdz brīdim, kad viņi attopas kopā draugu kāzās Austrālijā. Tāpēc viņi dara to, ko darītu jebkuri pieauguši cilvēki – izliekas par iemīlējušos pāri.

programme.title: Sliktie puiši uz mūžu
programme.desc: Kriminālkomēdija ar Vilu Smitu un Mārtinu Lorensu. Sliktie puiši dzīvo katrs savu dzīvi — Maikam ir pusmūža krīze, viņš braukā ar sporta automobiļiem un regulāri iekuļas nepatīkamās situācijās, bet Markuss ir nodibinājis ģimeni, kļuvis par policijas inspektoru un arvien biežāk sāk domāt par pensionēšanos. Taču, kad pēc Maika dzīvības sāk tīkot nezināmi noziedznieki, leģendārais duets, atceroties savu nesalaužamo zvērestu - "sliktie puiši uz mūžu" - atkal apvienojas, lai veiktu vēl vienu bīstamu misiju.

programme.title: Smurfi
programme.desc: Laipni lūdzam smurfu pasaulē! Burvis Gargamels ir piespiedis smurfus bēgt no dzimtā ciema. Ģimenes komēdija, kurā animācijas filmas varoņi parādās spēlfilmā.

programme.title: Jēzus atmoda
programme.desc: Iedvesmojoša biogrāfiska drāma par ticības, cerības un garīgas atmodas spēku laikā, kad sabiedrībā valda nemiers un sašķeltība. Filmas darbība risinās 20. gadsimta 70. gadu sākumā Amerikā, kur jauna paaudze, nogurusi no tradicionālajām vērtībām un dzīves tukšuma, meklē patiesību, mīlestību un piederību. Stāsta centrā ir neparasta draudzība starp konservatīvu mācītāju un harismātisku jauniešu līderi, kuri, pārvarot aizspriedumus un atšķirīgos uzskatus, kļūst par daļu no garīgas kustības, kas maina daudzu cilvēku dzīves. Caur personīgiem pārdzīvojumiem, konfliktiem un piedošanas tēmu filma atklāj, kā ticība spēj vienot cilvēkus un dot jaunu sākumu.

programme.title: Marmelāde
programme.desc: Filma par kādu ieslodzīto, kurš ar savu veiklo kameras biedru dalās paša izdomātā krāšņā, romantiskā bankas aplaupīšanas stāstā un izbēg, apvienojoties ar savas dzīves mīlestību.

programme.title: Čārlija eņģeļi
programme.desc: Noslēpumainā Čārlza Taunsenda detektīvaģentūra atvērusi birojus visā pasaulē. Tās paspārnē vairāku Bosliju vadībā izveidotas Eņģeļu komandas, kurās darbojas visgudrākās, visdrosmīgākās un visaugstāk kvalificētās sievietes, kam jātiek galā ar vissarežģītākajiem uzdevumiem jebkur uz zemeslodes.

programme.title: Džumandži: Nākamais līmenis
programme.desc: Pagājis gads, kopš Spensers un viņa draugi Marta, Fridžs un Betānija atrada veco videospēli Džumandži, un nu viņi katrs devušies savu ceļu. Tomēr noslēpumainās galda spēles spēkam nav robežu, un nemanot četrinieks no jauna nonāk bīstamajā, mistikas apvītajā valstībā. Tiesa, šoreiz spēle ir mainījusies. Džumandži apdraud varens pretinieks, un tas šo pasauli alkst iznīcināt. Spēlē iesprostotos sagaida lieli izaicinājumi, un, lai uzveiktu ļaundari, viņiem būs jāspēj sadarboties. Varoņu ceļš vedīs pāri tuksnešiem, džungļiem, oāzēm un sniegotiem kalniem – vai viņiem maz būs pa spēkam no turienes izkļūt dzīviem?

programme.title: Tauriņa stāsts
programme.desc: Tuvojoties ziemai, monarhu tauriņi migrē uz dienvidiem, lai pārziemotu siltumā. Taču Patrika spārni vēl nav gatavi tālajam ceļam, un viņš nevar lidot. Nedomādams padoties, Patriks kopā ar savu labāko draugu kāpuru Mārtiju paslēpjas pārtikas treilerī, kuru velk Dženifera. Tomēr arī viņai ir savas bažas par ceļojumu, jo - tauriņam neierasti - viņu māc bailes no augstuma. Visus trīs gaida daudz piedzīvojumu un sūri gūtu mācību, līdz mērķis būs sasniegts.

programme.title: Ledus laikmets 4: Kontinentu dreifs
programme.desc: Skrats netīšām izraisa kontinentālu kataklizmu, kuras rezultātā Menijs tiek nošķirts no Elijas un Persikas. Viņš atrodas uz aisberga kopā ar Djego, Sidu un Omīti, taču apņemas atgriezties mājās. Pēc šiem satriecošajiem notikumiem Sids satiek sen neredzētus ģimenes locekļus, turklāt draugiem būs jātiek galā ar dažādiem jauniem personāžiem, kuri apņēmušies liegt viņiem atgriezties mājās.

programme.title: Mošķu ģimenīte
programme.desc: Kas jauns mošķu pasaulē? Kāzas! Ragana un viņas iemīļotais Renfīlds, grāfa Drakulas sulainis, nolēmuši neslēpt savas jūtas un... salaulāties! Taču nupat sākusies laulību ceremonija tūdaļ pārtrūkst. Viesu acu priekšā mīlētājus nolaupa ar pārcilvēciskām spējām apveltītā mošķu medniece Mila. Šai mazulītei labāk netuvoties. Viņa ir ātrāka par vēju un apgādāta ar vismodernākajām tehnoloģijām - tās ieraugot, pat Džeimss Bonds viņu apskaustu.

programme.title: Neviens
programme.desc: Dažreiz tēvam visbīstamākās var izrādīties brīvdienas kopā ar ģimeni. Hačs – ģimenes galva ar slepenu pagātni un ļoti specifisku amatu –, ģimeni redz reti. Raujas vaiga sviedros, lai atmaksātu senu parādu. Kādu dienu ģimene nolemj doties atpūsties. Jau pirmajā brīvdienā pēc konflikta ar vietējiem viss saiet šķērsām un kļūst tikai sliktāk. Iesaistās vietējais (un korumpētais) šerifs un kriminālās pagrīdes karaliene. Hačam neatliek nekas cits, kā uzlocīt piedurknes un atvaļinājumā atgriezties darbā.

programme.title: Kā apmierināt sievieti
programme.desc: Kad Džīna zaudē kontroli pār savu tīrīšanas biznesu, kurā nodarbināti tikai vīrieši, viņai jāpieņem pašai sava seksualitāte, ja vēlas uzsākt jaunu dzīvi.

programme.title: Nezvēri
programme.desc: No dzimtenes izceļojis franču pāris Spānijas laukos vada organisko saimniecību, taču rodas nesaskaņas ar vietējiem ciemata iedzīvotājiem.

programme.title: Blefotājs
programme.desc: Ekscentrisks miljardieris Džeiks uzaicina vecos draugus uz riskantu pokera spēli, kurā likmes ir tik augstas kā vēl nekad. Taču svešinieku iebrukums izmaina vakara gaitu - tagad uz spēles ir liktas arī klātesošo dzīvības.

programme.title: Nejaukais es
programme.desc: Superļaundaris Gru ir izmests no darba, jo neapturēja jaunāko cilvēces apdraudētāju. Viņš zaudē dzīvesprieku, bet to atgūst, kad uzzina, ka viņa neredzētais dvīņubrālis Dru vēlas viņu satikt. Gru ar ģimeni dodas uz brāļa grezno dzīvesvietu. Brāļi kopā uzsāks cīņu pret Baltazaru Bretu, kurš bērnībā bija slavenība, taču tagad kļuvis par superļaundari, kurš terorizē pasauli. Minioni uzsāk protesta streiku pret to, ka Gru vispār neinteresē iespēja valdīt pār pasauli.

programme.title: Viesnīca Transilvānija
programme.desc: Slavenajā viesnīcā "Transilvānija", kura pieder labsirdīgajam vampīram Drakulam, viss it kā iet uz augšu - tagad to var apmeklēt arī cilvēki! Taču Draks noraizējies par to, ka viņa apburošajā mazdēliņā Denijā - pa pusei cilvēkā, pa pusei vampīrā _, ir daudz vairāk no cilvēka nekā no vampīra. Tāpēc viņš dod savai monstru komandai pavēli izmācīt puiku kā vien vajag, lai viņš kļūtu par īstu vampīru!

programme.title: Džūdija
programme.desc: Biogrāfiska drāma par izcilās ASV dziedātājas un aktrises Džūdijas Gārlendas dzīvi. Gārlenda 1968. gadā, gadu pirms savas nāves, devās uz Eiropu, lai koncertētu Londonā. Filmā attēloti pēdējie mēneši kinozvaigznes dzīvē, pirms viņa izdarīja pašnāvību.

programme.title: Rūķi atgriežas atkal
programme.desc: Helvijas pasaule sagriežas kājām gaisā, kad viņa atklāj, ka pastāv tehniski attīstītu rūķu banda no Vīnes, kas, pretstatā Helvijas klanam, ir nepārspējami jautrības un piedzīvojumu meklētāji. Vai Helvijas draudzība ar Bo, jaunāko no rūķu bandas, spēs samierināt abus rūķu klanus pēc vairāk nekā 250 gadu pārtraukuma?

programme.title: Pusotrs spiegs
programme.desc: Kelvins Džoiners (Kevins Hārts) skolas laikā bija populārais puisis. Divdesmit gadus vēlāk viņš ir veiksmīgs grāmatvedis, kuru pārsteidz ziņa no Boba Stouna. Izrādās, ka patiesībā viņš ir Robijs Vīrdikts (Dveins Džonsons) – apsmietais tīnis viņa skolā. Bobs ir trenējies divdesmit gadus un šobrīd ir izcils CIP aģents. Viņš algo Kelvinu, lai ar viņa grāmatvedības prasmju palīdzību izsekotu ierīci, kura ASV spiegošanas jomā var radīt jucekli. Dīvainais pāris sastopas ar pārspēku, taču viņiem sanāk arī daži varoņdarbi.

programme.title: Trusītis Pēterītis
programme.desc: Ir mierpilna diena vienā no skaistākajām Anglijas vietām. Putniņi mīlīgi čivina, strautiņš urdz, un saule apmirdz zaļos pakalnus. Te pēkšņi cauri zālājam aizšaujas pūkains kamoliņš. Tas ir trusītis Pēterītis, un viņš dodas ļoti svarīgā misijā. Kopā ar trim māsiņām trusītis Pēterītis spriņģo taisnā ceļā uz Makgregora kunga mazdārziņa pusi. Tur izaudzēti labu labie dārzeņi, kas tā vien prasās tik apēsti. Taču reiz namā uz dzīvi apmetas Makgregora kunga radinieks, kurš par nelūgtajiem dārza labumu čiepējiem nemaz nav sajūsmā. Tā sākas nikni ķīviņi, jautri piedzīvojumi un daudz nepatikšanu, kurās trusītis Pēterītis kopā ar draugiem pamanīsies iekulties.

programme.title: Palaidnīgā feja
programme.desc: 337 gadus jaunajai zobu fejai Violetai maģija nešķiet īpaši aizraujoša, tāpēc viņa vienīgā nespēj nokārtot eksāmenu, lai iegūtu kristālu, kas fejām ļauj iekļūt cilvēku pasaulē. Violeta neļauj skumjām vaļu, nozog kristālu citai fejai un nokļūst 12 gadus vecās bārenītes Maksijas istabā. Tomēr, ak vai! Kristāls saplīst, un nu Violeta ir iesprostota cilvēku pasaulē! Kopā ar Maksiju viņa meklē atpakaļceļu un atklāj savu patieso aicinājumu.

programme.title: Ferdinands
programme.desc: Ferdinands ir pats labsirdīgākais bullis visā Spānijā. Neskatoties uz iespaidīgajiem izmēriem un milzu spēku, viņš jau kopš bērnības neizrādīja sevišķu interesi par badīšanos ar saviem sugas brāļiem. Nejaušības dēļ Ferdinands nokļūst to vidū, kuri tiek izvēlēti, lai piedalītos buļļu cīņās Madridē. Tagad Ferdinandam nāksies aizstāvēt savus miermīlīgos dzīves uzskatus un atgādināt pārējiem, ka grūtību priekšā galvenais ir palikt, kāds tu esi. Jo tikai tā tu spēsi izmainīt pasauli sev apkārt.

programme.title: Ledus laikmets: Lielā sadursme
programme.desc: Skreta (Kriss Vedžs) nepārtrauktie pūliņi noglabāt savu zīli, liek viņam izraisīt negadījumu virkni, kuru rezultātā asteroīdi sāk traukties uz Zemi. Haoss liek Manijam (Rejs Romano), Djego (Deniss Līrijs), Sidam (Džons Legvizamo) un viņu ģimenēm meklēt patvērumu. Piedzīvojumu meklētāja zebiekste Baks (Saimons Pegs) viņus brīdina, ka var sākties masveida izmiršana, kas liek draugiem meklēt jaunu mājvietu, pa ceļam satiekot citus dzīvniekus un apmeklējot eksotiskas vietas.

programme.title: Džeisons Borns
programme.desc: Bijusī CIP slepenā aģente Nikija Pārsone (Džūlija Stailza) reiz palīdzēja Bornam (Mets Deimons), pēc tam nozuda un šobrīd strādā kopā ar ziņotāju, kurš gatavojas nodot atklātībā CIP slepenās specoperācijas. Nikija ielaužas CIP sistēmā un lejupielādē visu, kas saistīts ar specoperācijām, tostarp operāciju "Dzirnakmens", kurā piedalījās Borns. CIP aģente Hetera Lī (Alīsija Vikandere) atklāj ielaušanos un par to ziņo CIP direktoram Robertam Dūvijam (Tomijs Lī Džonss), kurš ir specoperāciju galvenais vadītājs.

programme.title: Strāvas karš
programme.desc: Dramatisks sāncensības stāsts par elektrības atklāšanas laikmeta titāniem Tomasu Edisonu un Džordžu Vestinghausu, lai noskaidrotu, kura izgudrotā elektriskā sistēma būs noteicošā modernizētajā pasaulē.

programme.title: Pieskāriens
programme.desc: Romantisks un saviļņojošs stāsts, kas aptver vairākus gadu desmitus un kontinentus. Viena vīrieša emocionāls ceļojums, kurā viņš cenšas atrast savu pirmo mīlestību, kas pazuda pirms 50 gadiem.

programme.title: Brāļi Sisteri
programme.desc: Pārgalvīgie brāļi ar dīvainajiem uzvārdiem ir zeltrača un avantūrista Vorma meklējumos - šo uzdevumu viņi ir saņēmuši no noslēpumainā Komandora. Būdami atlīdzības mednieki, dzenoties pakaļ savam jaunajam upurim, viņi pat nenojauš, ka ir iepinušies bīstamā spēlē, kurā savus neapvaldāmos raksturus būs jāapvieno ar asu prātu un prasmi rīkoties ar ieroci.

programme.title: Pēdējais elpas vilciens
programme.desc: Patiess stāsts par dziļjūras nirējiem, kas cīnās, lai izglābtu savu komandas biedru, iesprostotu desmitiem metru zem okeāna virsmas.

programme.title: MotoGP. Nīderlande. Kvalifikācija. Moto3
programme.desc: Motorcycle racing action from the Netherlands. With coverage of all the thrills and spills from the Moto3 Grand Prix taking place at the TT Circuit Assen: a famous motorcycle racing circuit in the Dutch city of Assen which has earned the nickname "The Cathedral" amongst motorsports fans.

programme.title: MotoGP. Nīderlande. Kvalifikācija. Moto2
programme.desc: Motorcycle racing action from the Netherlands. With coverage of all the thrills and spills from the Moto2 Grand Prix taking place at the TT Circuit Assen: a famous motorcycle racing circuit in the Dutch city of Assen which has earned the nickname "The Cathedral" amongst motorsports fans.

programme.title: MotoGP: Grand Prix of Assen
programme.desc: Motorcycle racing coverage from the Netherlands. With action from the MotoGP, riders from around the world take part in the Motorcycling Grand Prix at the TT Circuit Assen: a famous motorcycle racing circuit in the Dutch city of Assen.

programme.title: Futbols: Bundesliga. Borussia - Leverkusen
programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. programme.title: Teniss: Wimbledon. 1. diena
programme.desc: Wimbledon is more than just a tennis tournament — it's a summer tradition, a slice of British culture, and one of the most iconic sporting events in the world. Held every year in London, England, usually in late June to early July, it's where the best tennis players on the planet come to battle it out on the famous grass courts of the All England Club. It's actually the oldest tennis tournament in the world, dating back to 1877, and it's still the only Grand Slam played on grass — the fastest and most unpredictable surface. That's part of what makes it so exciting. Matches are intense, fast-paced, and full of surprises. Wimbledon is packed with unique traditions that make it stand out. Players are required to wear all white on court — no exceptions. The crowd enjoys strawberries and cream, and you won't see flashy ads around the court — it's all about the game. And of course, there's the Royal Box, where you might spot celebrities or even members of the British Royal Family watching the action. From rising stars to tennis legends, everyone dreams of lifting the famous Wimbledon trophy. There's something magical about seeing players walk onto Centre Court, hearing the roar of the crowd, and witnessing moments that go down in sports history. Whether you're a tennis fan or just love great sports drama, Wimbledon is a must-watch — classy, thrilling, and full of unforgettable moments.

Teniss: Wimbledon. 8. korts
programme.desc: Vimbldona nav tikai tenisa turnīrs — tā ir vasaras tradīcija, daļa no britu kultūras un viens no slavenākajiem sporta notikumiem pasaulē. Katru gadu jūnija beigās un jūlija sākumā tā notiek Londonā, Anglijā, kur pasaules labākie tenisisti sacenšas uz leģendārajiem zālāja kortiem All England Club klubā. Tā ir vecākā tenisa sacensība pasaulē, kura aizsākās jau 1877. gadā, un joprojām ir vienīgais "Grand Slam" turnīrs, kas notiek uz zāles seguma — ātrākā un neprognozējamākā laukuma. Tieši tas padara spēles tik aizraujošas un dinamiskas! Vimbldona ir slavena ar savām unikālajām tradīcijām. Spēlētājiem obligāti jābūt tērptiem baltā apģērbā, tribīnēs skatītāji bauda zemenes ar putukrējumu, bet ap laukumiem nav reklāmu — šeit viss ir par un ap tenisu. Un, protams, ir arī karaliskā loža, kur bieži redzami slaveni cilvēki vai pat Britu karaliskās ģimenes pārstāvji. Katrs tenisists sapņo pacelt Vimbldonas trofeju. Ir īpašs brīdis, kad spēlētāji iznāk uz Centre Court, tribīnes uzgavilē, un tiek radīti vēsturiski sporta mirkļi. Pat ja neesi liels tenisa fans — Vimbldonu noteikti ir vērts skatīties. Tā ir eleganta, aizraujoša un pilna ar neaizmirstamiem brīžiem.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Long before banks, ATMs and check-cashing services, there were pawn shops. Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. It's up to them to determine what's real and what's fake, as they reveal the often surprising answer to the questions on everyone's mind, "What's the story behind it?" and "What's it worth?"

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Explores the controversial theory that extraterrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years. Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago?

programme.title: Greatest Mysteries with Laurence Fishburne
programme.desc: Investigate a wide range of historically compelling topics and the mysteries surrounding each including the Titanic, D.B. Cooper, Roswell, John Wilkes Booth, and more. Each program within the franchise will showcase fresh, new evidence and perspectives including never-before-released documents to the general public, personal diaries and DNA evidence to unearth brand-new information about these infamous and enigmatic chapters in history.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: A&E presents the new original real-life series "Storage Wars," which follows professional buyers and their teams as they scour repossessed storage units in search of hidden treasure. Part gamblers, part detectives, these auction pros have found everything from coffins to the world's most valuable comic book collection, paying as little as ten dollars for items valued in the millions. Each episode of "Storage Wars" follows a group of bidders as they get a quick peek inside the units, aided only by the beam of a flashlight. They then must assess on the spot if the unit is worth a bid and how high they will actually go to grasp the gold. The high-stakes fun begins as we see if the resulting buy is full of mostly trash... or true treasure. Driven by Dan Dotson, one of the most successful and outrageous auctioneers in the country, the cast of buyers is as colorful and varied as the treasures they uncover.

programme.title: Unidentified: Inside America's UFO Investigation
programme.desc: In December of 2017, The New York Times published a stunning front-page exposé about the Pentagon's mysterious UFO program, the Advanced Aerospace Threat Identification Program (AATIP). Featuring an interview with a former military intelligence official and Special Agent In-Charge, Luis Elizondo, who confirmed the existence of the hidden government program, the controversial story was the focus of worldwide attention. Previously run by Elizondo, AATIP was created to research and investigate Unidentified Aerial Phenomena (UAP) including numerous videos of reported encounters, three of which were released to a shocked public in 2017. Elizondo resigned after expressing to the government that these UAPs could pose a major threat to our national security and not enough was being done to deal with them or address our potential vulnerabilities. Now, as a part of HISTORY's groundbreaking new six-part, one-hour limited series UNIDENTIFIED: INSIDE AMERICA'S UFO INVESTIGATION, Elizondo is speaking out for the first time with Tom DeLonge, co-founder and President of To The Stars Academy of Arts & Science and Chris Mellon, former Deputy Assistant Secretary of Defense and Intelligence, to expose a series of startling encounters and embark on fascinating new investigations that will urge the public to ask questions and look for answers. The series will reveal newly authenticated evidence and footage, interviews from eyewitnesses and former military personnel who have never spoken out before, and extensive breakthroughs in understanding the technology behind these unknown phenomena in our skies.

programme.title: The UnXplained with William Shatner
programme.desc: From the producers of Ancient Aliens® and The Curse of Oak Island® From alleged UFO encounters to sudden disappearances to evil possessions, series host William Shatner attempts to get to the truth behind the most bizarre and mysterious events ever reported. With the help of the world's top scientists, first-hand "experiencer" accounts, and dramatic reenactments, viewers gain shocking insight into what's really happening--and why.

programme.title: The Tesla Files
programme.desc: Why were trunks belonging to genius inventor Nikola Tesla confiscated in 1943? Did they contain the plans for nearly free worldwide electricity, massive death rays, and other inventions out of the future? A new investigation driven by declassified CIA documents suggests a secret history of bitter rivalries, government conspiracies, Cold War and WW2 spycraft, extra-terrestrial communication, and amazing achievements of a truly gifted man – Nikola Tesla.

programme.title: Gold Hunters: Legend of the Superstition Mountains
programme.desc: Legend tells of the Lost Dutchman's gold mine hidden somewhere within the 160,000 acres of brutal Arizona desert known as the "Superstition Mountains." The promise of a $200 million mother lode has lured thousands of treasure hunters and continues to claim the lives of those eager to decipher the legend's clues and riddles. Hunting for the Lost Dutchman is typically a one-man journey, but lifelong Dutch Hunter Wayne Tuttle is breaking with tradition and partnering with a team of experts to follow a newly revealed clue that could finally solve the 500-year-old mystery of America's most famous and deadliest buried treasure. With cursed mountains said to drive men mad and a hidden fortune of gold worth killing for, the treasure hunter's greatest danger may be the man at his side. Trust at your own peril if you dare to tread into HISTORY's Legend of the Superstition Mountains.

programme.title: U-Boat Wargamers
programme.desc: When WW2 breaks out, an elite force of German U-boat commanders attempt to starve Britain into submission. Vera Mathews heads the reformed WRENS. Meanwhile retired naval commander Gilbert Roberts is desperate to return to his career.

programme.title: Serial Killer Earth
programme.desc: In recent years the destructive power of natural disasters has been recorded, from Hurricane Katrina to the earthquake and tsunami that devastated Japan. Serial Killer Earth brings together a top team of experts to examine the most compelling footage from news and home video, as well as eyewitness testimony, in order to explain, understand and inform viewers of what actually happened during these disasters and how they compare and contrast with the most historic natural disasters of the past.

programme.title: MonsterQuest
programme.desc: In the marshy swamp land of Texarkana a legendary beast has hunted the residents of a small Arkansas town. Their story was immortalized in a well known movie, The Legend of Boggy Creek. The real events were a series of violent nocturnal attacks that left behind not only fear and panic but also remarkable tracks. But the evidence is not just confined to history. Scientific clues continue to this day and point to a malevolent monster that stalks the Deep South.

programme.title: Life After People
programme.desc: This unique documentary series explores what the planet would look like if all human life diappeared. With comment and opinion coming from scientists, engineers and other experts, this show speculates on how a lack of human intervention would impact on the environment and the other animal species. The show does not provide any explanation as to why humans have vanished from the face of the Earth but does surmise that human infrastructure is still present along with pets and domesticated livestock. Each episode explores what would happen to specific structures such as skyscrapers, bridges and dams or details the impact on human remains, artefacts and other objects. Some real-life abandoned locations are discussed and the show also uses CGI dramatisations to depict how the situation would look after one day, one week, one year, 10 years, 15 years, 25 years, 50 years, 100 years, 200 years, etc.

programme.title: Brad Meltzer's Lost History
programme.desc: American history is vanishing one artifact at a time. Some of our most important historical and cultural treasures have been lost or stolen. Every year, dozens of treasures, from George Washington's teeth to the Apollo 11 moon landing tapes to even the iconic ground zero flag from the September 11 attacks, vanish from the shelves of famous museums, government archives and private collections. Now, host Brad Meltzer leads the hunt to return these treasures to their rightful owners–the American people. Many lost artifacts are circulating on the black market, but dozens of previously lost objects have already been found—by ordinary citizens—in attics, at garage sales and even online. Brad will also enlist the help of viewers, giving the public the chance to help restore our history too.

programme.title: Lost Worlds
programme.desc: Documentary series that brings back to life lost cities, structures, cultures, and civilisations, transporting viewers back in time and revealing the truth behind some of history's most iconic eras. Using a combination of cutting-edge technology and archaeological research, the team detail what life was like for these places during their peak of their powers, and use visual overlays to compare past and present landscapes. From the Knights Templar to the lost city of Atlantis, ancient Egypt to Hitler's planned supercity, and ancient Athens to America's wild west, each episodes dives into these extraordinary remnants of human history.

programme.title: Rome: Rise & Fall of an Empire
programme.desc: When Roman generals Pompey and Crassus lead their mighty legions of soldiers and mercenaries into the lands surrounding Italy, neither could anticipate the turmoil caused by one bold mercenary: Spartacus. A Thracian warrior, Spartacus deserts the Roman army, but is captured and made a slave, forced to fight as a gladiator. But in 73 BC the untamable barbarian leads a slave revolt of 70,000 gladiators against the Roman Republic. Though the brutal and conniving Roman General Crassus is finally able to suppress the revolt, his rival, the more popular Pompey, takes all the credit, sparking a division within the Republic itself that will ultimately spell its demise.

programme.title: Warriors
programme.desc: The Romans, with the greatest army in the world, are annihilated by Germanic tribes at the Battle of Teutoburg Forest. Go inside the culture of some of the most famous warriors to explore their weaponry, tactics and, ultimately, their psyche.

programme.title: Ancient Discoveries
programme.desc: From conquering the depths of the oceans to defending the freedoms of the seas--ancient man pushed the technological boundaries to the limits in the mega battle for the oceans. New discoveries will reveal how an ancient destroyer rammed its way to victory in one of the most significant battles in human history. In Denmark, a team of divers build and test the world's first ever deep sea diving suit that was designed 350 years before the history books tell us it was possible to walk along the seabed. Can CSI science unravel the mystery of a time traveling ghost ship? And in a groundbreaking sea cannon experiment, naval experts will discover how a 16th century war fleet blasted their way to victory against an enemy armada seven miles wide, without the loss of a single ship.

programme.title: Rome: Rise & Fall of an Empire

programme.title: Engineering Disasters
programme.desc: Engineering has built our modern world. Everything from skyscrapers to roads and air travel exist because of advances in engineering. What happens when engineering goes horribly wrong? Engineering Disasters goes beyond the headlines to uncover what really happened in the most notorious engineering accidents. What caused an outdoor stage to collapse in Indiana, killing seven? How did a collection of classic Corvettes disappear right out of thin air? Why did a plane's fuselage rip open in mid-flight? What was behind the collapse of a domed stadium? Each hour long episode combines expert and eyewitness interviews, state of the art graphics and dramatic 'moment of disaster' footage to tell the story behind the world's most terrifying engineering disasters.

programme.title: Ancient Top

programme.title: The Universe
programme.desc: Every day, new information is discovered that helps us better understand how our Universe works. Some of this evidence solves mysteries dating back thousands of years. programme.title: Ancient Discoveries
programme.desc: Have a look at the technologies from the past. You will be surprised to find out in what extent ancient knowledge influences modern technology. As well the series uses contributions from archaeologists and other experts, footage of historical sites and artifacts and dramatized reconstructions.

programme.title: Clash of the Gods
programme.desc: Documentary series that in each episode explains the heroic and tragic life of various figures from Greek and Norse mythologies - the most powerful monsters, heroes and Gods, including Thor, Hercules, Beowulf, Minotaur, Odysseus and Zeus. Was ancient Greece's greatest hero Hercules a real person? What inspired the Minotaur's labyrinth? Did Odysseus's famous journey really happen? This series will answer these and many other questions, and experts will connect the myths we all know to actual historical events, and link the stories to mythologies of other cultures as well.

programme.title: Digging for the Truth
programme.desc: Digging for the Truth was a History Channel television series. The first three seasons of the show focused on host Josh Bernstein, who journeyed on various explorations of historical icons and mysteries. Bernstein is the president and CEO of BOSS and has a degree in anthropology and psychology from Cornell University. The show airs every Monday night at 9:00 EST on the History Channel. The series premiered in January, 2005 and has since become the highest-rated series in the history of The History Channel, which was surprising given the previous show "Time Titans" from the production crew never made it past the pilot. The third season premiered on January 22, 2007, with a 2-hour special event on the quest for Atlantis. Bernstein announced on February 20, 2007, that he would be leaving The History Channel and Digging for the Truth, and would, as of April, join The Discovery Channel as an executive producer and host of a new prime-time series and specials. Hunter Ellis, host of Tactical to Practical and Man, Moment, Machine for The History Channel, then replaced Josh Bernstein as host.

Each episode deals with a specific murder that's been commited in one of the small towns that make up this iconic region of the US with the locals enhancing the tales and bringing clues to our attention. The show includes interviews with the victim's family, friends, law enforcement officers and also provides dramatic reenactments to bring the stories to life. Episodes reveal true stories such as when an Oklahoma family's dog drops a human skull onto their porch and the police are called in to investigate; a bride-to-be who discovers her betrothed shot in the head in their living room; a beloved father, son and fiancee who is discovered beaten to death in his own driveway; and a devoted family man who diappears after his truck is set on fire.

programme.title: Evil Lives Here: Shadows Of Death
programme.desc: Evil casts a shadow. That shadow spreads outward for years, even decades, after a crime. It consumes everyone in its path, pulling them into darkness. Can they find the light? Evil Lives Here: Shadows of Death explores the endless reach of evil, a reach that extends long after the act of evil itself. This original series highlights the struggle to survive as innocent people find themselves caught in the wake of death and evil.

programme.title: People Magazine Investigates
programme.desc: Investigation Discovery and People magazine partner to re-examine some of the most high profile crime cases in recent history. The one-hour series brings viewers tales of betrayal, buried secrets and unsung heroes, ripped from the pages of one of the nation's top weekly magazines. These stories transcended news and became part of pop culture, revealing shocking twists, new evidence, and unexpected resolutions. Interlaced within every episode are exclusive interviews with People's journalists, archival footage, re-creations, and firsthand accounts by those closest to the investigations.

programme.title: Crimes Gone Viral
programme.desc: Crimes Gone Viral explores the riveting stories behind shocking crimes caught on camera that gain viral fame on the internet. From business security cameras to home surveillance systems and cell phone cameras, someone is almost always watching. Gripping clips of kidnappings, break-ins, wild car chases, violent road rage incidents and other crimes rack up millions of views. But CRIMES GONE VIRAL goes beyond the jaw-dropping footage to tell the full story. This series features compelling interviews and behind-the-scenes information of some of the internet's most viral crime clips.

programme.title: Southern Fried Homicide
programme.desc: Across the Deep South, heat, humidity and darn good hiding places provide a perfect backdrop for dark, despicable deeds. Southern Fried Homicide transports viewers into the steamy, Southern subculture whose lifestyles and charming drawls are captivating viewers - and covering up crimes. SOUTHERN FRIED HOMICIDE probes the juiciest stories from down in the Bible Belt, from the Carolinas to Louisiana and Tennessee. The premiere episode on June 5 at 10/9C profiles an old adage in the south: families are a bit like fudge - mostly sweet, but with a few nuts. After pedigreed Southern belle Susie Newsom's marriage fails, sweet Susie spirals and starts to have an affair...with her disturbed first cousin. When the rest of the family isn't exactly thrilled with the kissing cousins, their scandalous relationship ends with nine family members dead, spanning from Kentucky to North Carolina. SOUTHERN FRIED HOMICIDE proves that ugliness lurks behind Southern beauty when cracks in moral society give way to cold-blooded murder. Actress Shanna Forrestall, a native belle of Louisiana, serves as the gatekeeper to these salacious stories that give another meaning to things that "go south."

programme.title: Disappeared
programme.desc: A person suddenly and unexpectedly disappears; no trace, no clues, nothing but the lingering mystery they leave behind. According to the FBI's National Crime Information Center, there are now 110,484 active missing persons cases in the U.S., 53% are juveniles under the age of 18. Most of us have heard of the high-profile cases, such as Natalee Holloway, Stacey Peterson, and Chandra Levy. But have you ever heard of Mae Catherine Rocker, Alexis Peterson or Thomas Jay Kerr? Probably not. They are just a few of the hundreds of thousands of people in this country who one day, simply Disappeared. Most missing person's stories have never been told...until now. Disappeared is an exciting series that investigates the disappearance of these victims, who are here one minute, gone the next. Each episode focuses on one victim's story, as told through the perspectives and actual voices of their closest friends and family and the investigators trying to solve the case. Through interviews with family, friends, police, and searchers, each episode recounts the actions, thoughts, circumstances and motivations that led to each person's disappearance. Experience the victim's final hours until they vanished. Watch interviews with experts, from psychologists to forensic specialists to psychics, who will offer new insights into what may have happened in each case, whether the person was a victim of foul play or a runaway. Disappeared will take you inside the world of the missing, where a person can vanish without a trace, investigators race against the clock to solve a mystery, and the victim's anguished family and friends are left to wonder what in the world could have happened.

programme.title: Reasonable Doubt
programme.desc: As we all know, the initial verdict in a trial is not always the final outcome as many trial jury decisions are often overturned on appeal. However, the appeals process can take a significant amount of time to go through the system and also incur enormous costs on the individuals involved. This show follows the work of two investigators who re-examine the verdicts in contentious murder cases and assess the prospects of a successful appeal for the families of the people convicted of the crimes to determine if they should appeal or accept the verdict. Each episode traces the developments in the case, whether it be new evidence or witness testimony, which can then shed light on the innocence of the convicted person or show that, indeed, they are guilty of the crime and the verdict was correct.

programme.title: The Murder Of Grace Millane: A Faking It Special
programme.desc: A body language analyst, linguistics expert and forensic psychologist scrutinise the prime suspect for the murder of British backpacker Grace Millane.

programme.title: Bad Henry
programme.desc: Set against the backdrop of 1990s Charlotte, a city divided by racial tensions, raging gang violence and drug crime, this documentary series reveals the story of an even more sinister atrocity, that of the serial killer Henry Louis Wallace. When the body of Brandi Henderson is found strangled in her Charlotte home, police recognize that it is the second such murder in three weeks and that they have a serial killer on their hands. With a pattern emerging across the city of young African American women being raped and strangled to death, this show tells how detective Garry McFadden, the only African American on the homicide squad at the time, and his dedicated team at the Charlotte-Mecklenburg police department tracked and caught this ruthless killer.

programme.desc: Investigative journalist Maria Elena Salinas uses her years of experience to unearth new evidence in criminal cases that have made national headlines. This series sees Maria seeking truths about crimes committed on US soil, finding the evidence to overturn wrongful convictions, uncovering the clues to prosecute murderers and helping families find closure.

programme.title: Холивар. История Рунета
programme.desc: Авторский мини-сериал Андрея Лошака рассказывает о том, как возник в России интернет, прозванный "рунетом", и как он со временем менялся. Развитие рунета отразило все социальные и политические изменения в российском обществе: полная свобода в 90-х годах, бурный рост экономики в нулевых и введение цензуры и запретительных законов в десятые. Последние 7 лет государство активно пытается взять "рунет" под контроль.

programme.title: Детали
programme.desc: Китайская операционная система, которая станет альтернативой "Андроиду". Как быстро заживлять переломы и другие повреждения в условиях микрогравитации. Найдено лекарство от лихорадки Эбола. В США с 1982 года работает детский лагерь, где готовят будущих космонавтов и учат посадке на Марс.

programme.title: Детали
programme.desc: В Гренландии рекордными темпами тают ледники, а в Африке сокращается популяция жирафов. Ученые изучают пауков и их сети, чтобы создавать новые материалы. Как новые технологии помогают композиторам писать музыку?

programme.title: Детали
programme.desc: Eженедельный телевизионный проект Русской службы "Голоса Америки", в котором ведущий Андрей Деркач рассказывает о научных открытиях и высокотехнологичных разработках в таких сферах, как медицина, космос, информационные технологии. Корреспонденты программы на себе испытывают новинки рынка hi-tech, общаются с создателями всего того, что делает нашу жизнь интереснее, безопаснее и удобнее.

programme.title: Неизвестная Россия
programme.desc: Aвторский проект Вадима Кондакова. Это получасовые документальные истории о местах и людях, о которых мало кто знает. И которые станут для зрителя настоящим открытием. Автор побывал в самой самой западной точке страны, в Калининграде, где люди, без света и воды, живут в казематах заброшенного немецкого форта XIX века. И на далеких Курильских островах, в городе-призраке, про жителей которых почему-то забыли на материке. Кроме того, "Неизвестная Россия" расскажет о том, что за таинственный сигнал из космоса поймали в астрофизической обсерватории Нижнего Архыза. И можно ли стать дорожным полицейским, если ты родился в городе дальнобойщиков. В общем, "Неизвестная Россия" показывает страну такой, какой ее не знают даже сами россияне.

programme.title: Анатомия убийства
programme.desc: Евгения и Сергей расстались, но она осталась работать патологоанатомом в местной полиции по приглашению следователя Перфильева. Сергей Карский получил возможность наслаждаться славой. После публикации его романа, который он написал не без участия Евгении, но что-то в их отношениях сломалось. Его друг, встретившись с Женей по работе, был крайне удивлён таким течением событий. Прекрасный специалист в своём деле Евгения продолжает раскрывать запутанные преступления, и Карский всегда готов оказаться рядом с ней во время поисков разгадок. Перфильев внимательнейшим образом относится ко всем предположениям талантливой коллеги...

programme.title: Можете звать меня папой
programme.desc: Молодой, красивый парень Паша работает... заведующим детского сада. Он романтик и идеалист - за это его и любит Вера. Ребята собираются пожениться, но для начала Вере надо представить жениха своему папе. Она уверена: ее любимые мужчины обязательно поладят и оценят друг друга. Паша принимает Вериного отца с открытой душой и готов уже называть его папой… но тут выясняется, что у добродушного пенсионера - полные шкафы скелетов. И не исключено, что это не просто фигура речи. По ночам он встречается со странными личностями, оговаривает какие-то загадочные "операции". Его почему-то боятся соседи. А в сарае у него - тазик с бетоном, в котором застыли чьи-то ботинки… Что за секреты хранит этот "папа" и как вырвать любимую из цепких лап мафии?

programme.title: Желание сердца
programme.desc: Жизнь Сийма, отца большого семейства, необратимо изменилась, когда в семье родился сын Кармо. У мальчика диагностировали генетическое заболевание - "болезнь хрупких костей". Воспитание особенного ребенка открыло сердца обоих родителей, поэтому много времени они посвящают волонтерству, помогая другим. Однако самая большая тревога семьи связана с сыном. Постоянные переломы приковали 7-летнего мальчишку к инвалидной коляске и большую часть времени он вынужден находиться дома. Но заветное желание родителей - чтобы их ребенок мог ходить в школу, как все его сверстники.

programme.title: Ремонт на сдачу
programme.desc: В увлекательной программе "Ремонт на сдачу" с вами поделятся хитрыми и доступными советами по дизайну интерьера. Помогать домовладельцам будут любительница дизайна интерьера и ведущая Кейли Сюкияйнен и самый энергичный в Эстонии энтузиаст интерьера в социальных сетях Мерлин Мийдо. За две недели, с бюджетом в 1000 евро, они превратят невзрачную квартиру в место, которое арендатор захочет назвать своим домом с первого взгляда.

programme.title: Я иду тебя искать
programme.desc: Мила Пятница, без пяти минут выпускница юридической академии, попадает на практику в Управление МВД. Первым ее делом становится убийство антиквара Власова. Главный подозреваемый найден без сознания рядом с убитым. Выясняется, что гибель антиквара как-то связана с делом 1983 года о пропаже старинных часов. Мила расследует трагические события прошлого, чтобы понять, что стало причиной нынешнего убийства и как с этим связан подозреваемый.

programme.title: Я иду тебя искать 2. За закрытыми дверями
programme.desc: Мила Пятница с Максимом Швецом, опытным следователем, расследует необычные дела, зацепки для которых часто находятся в архиве. В одной из квартир дома, попавшего под снос, несколько дней никто не отвечает на звонки. Вскрыв дверь, обнаруживают труп пожилой женщины — отравление лекарственными препаратами. Все вроде бы говорит в пользу версии о самоубийстве, но Мила вновь видит причину в прошлом: когда-то в этом же доме уже случилось убийство. Мила найдет в архиве это дело и откроет давно закрытую дверь, за которой скрываются чужие секреты. Впрочем, одна из множества тайн, которые хранит архив, возможно, связана также с семьей Милы.

programme.title: Следствие вели...
programme.desc: Эти уголовные дела гремели на весь Советский Союз. По ним были написаны романы и сняты художественные фильмы. Их фигуранты — миллионеры эпохи социализма, хитроумные воры, профессиональные грабители и валютчики. Они бросили вызов советскому обществу. Вызов приняли лучшие сыщики страны. В их распоряжении не было компьютеров, сотовой связи и бойцов ОМОНа. Но это не мешало вершиться правосудию. Банда "Черная кошка", дело банды советских гангстеров конца 60-х годов, прозванных "Фантомасами", увлекательная история налетчика Леонида Пантелеева, "свободного художника-грабителя" — эти случаи вошли в историю отечественной криминалистики. Но главная цель сериала — не просто рассказать о преступлениях и злоумышленниках советского времени, а показать ушедшую эпоху так, чтобы молодые зрители смогли прочувствовать дух ушедшего времени, а зрители постарше — ностальгию по прошлому.

programme.title: Пласт
programme.desc: Большой Босс Евгений Сергеевич поручает Славе и Жене реализовать партию контрабандного солнечного камня. Слава и Женя — друзья, которые промышляют янтарем с детства. В 90-е у них был шанс подняться и стать обеспеченными людьми, но одно обстоятельство, произошедшее по вине Славы, навсегда лишило их этой возможности. После получения от Евгения Сергеевича большой партии в голове у Жени возникает план, как быстро разбогатеть и стать тем человеком, которым он всегда мечтал быть.

programme.title: Музыкальная интуиция
programme.desc: Вокально-экспериментальное шоу "Музыкальная интуиция" объединит и перемешает профессиональных вокалистов с теми, кто совершенно не умеет петь. В каждом выпуске две команды звездных судей будут соревноваться между собой. Им предстоит угадывать, кто из участников, выходящих на сцену, обладает великолепным вокалом, а кто выступает только в караоке. Члены жюри не смогут слышать, как поют участники, им придется делать выбор, опираясь лишь на сценические навыки выступающих и свою интуицию.

programme.title: Холивар. История Рунета
programme.desc: Авторский мини-сериал Андрея Лошака рассказывает о том, как возник в России интернет, прозванный "рунетом", и как он со временем менялся. Развитие рунета отразило все социальные и политические изменения в российском обществе: полная свобода в 90-х годах, бурный рост экономики в нулевых и введение цензуры и запретительных законов в десятые. Последние 7 лет государство активно пытается взять "рунет" под контроль.

programme.title: Холивар. История Рунета
programme.desc: Авторский мини-сериал Андрея Лошака рассказывает о том, как возник в России интернет, прозванный "рунетом", и как он со временем менялся.
